name: l2cap_unregister_psm_handler

ownership.argument: Public remove half of the PSM registry.

provenance.source: Submitted by the public wrapper 0xC805AC4. Finds the registry entry at *(owner)+16 whose +4 psm and +6 kind match the request, unlinks it through 0xC7EAD28, and for kind <= 3 walks the channel list to retire the channels bound to that PSM before freeing both the entry and the request node.

notes: Public remove half of the PSM registry.
